desc: Prove the canonical two-phase schedule and rule out unnecessary or more-than-twice flips.
Determine the optimal subset of temporarily disabled matched 1-bits, including the prefix property.
Derive an efficient incremental or closed-form cost evaluation for every candidate subset.
Correct the on-phase insertion update in the incremental cost computation.
Implement and validate the corrected \(O(N\log N)\) Python solution.
Verify edge cases and all provided samples.
